logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for a data-center compute package decision brief. Main element: a horizontal bar chart titled 'Measured energy per acceptance batch (Wh)' comparing four packages on one shared test basis, ordered ascending by the client's energy-first policy: P3 = 10 Wh, P2 = 22 Wh, P1 = 28 Wh, P4 = 49 Wh. One identical neutral blue bar style for all four packages; no bar may be highlighted, recolored, annotated with callouts, or marked with arrows, and bars must be exactly proportional to their values (P4's bar is 4.9x P3's bar). X-axis 0-55 Wh with labeled gridlines every 10 Wh and value labels at each bar end. Small subtitle: 'Identical workload, output requirement and test conditions.' Footnote strip: 'Client policy: quality at least 80, defects at most 5, lowest energy wins; P3 selected.' Flat vector style, white background, sans-serif labels, no 3D, no gradients, no decorative icons, no extra packages.
